testcase.name: Scenario: Keep a pinned expansion open while opening another panel: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:247:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep a pinned expansion open while opening another panel ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is visible ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open and pinned ✔ When the user opens the Simplification additional command area ✔ Then both the Modify and Simplification additional command areas are visible ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the Simplification additional command area closes ✔ And the pinned Modify additional command area remains visible ✔ When the user unpins Modify and clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the Modify additional command area closes
